answer: Random jury sampling of 9 from the identity pool: a farm holding fraction k wins a full jury only k^9 of the time. The juniper labels each draw, making capture probability visible and auditable. This creates a ripple in expected payoff—honest participation dominates because marginal stake yields linear returns while attack cost scales exponentially. Any operator hits the onyx of negative EV well before controlling 30% of seats. The mechanism works because k^9 collapses faster than any feasible stake advantage can grow.
